description: This source file provides utilities for transcoding JPEG images, including error handling, image decoding, resizing, orientation normalization, and quality/size management. It defines a JPEGTranscoder struct with functions to re-encode images with size and quality constraints.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible errors during JPEG transcoding processes, including decode failures, missing properties, encode failures, and size limit exceeded conditions.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: Struct providing static methods for transcoding JPEG images, including quality clamping and converting images with size and compression constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Ensures the quality value remains within a prescribed range (0.05 to 1.0).

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main method that re-encodes image data to JPEG format, optionally downscaling to fit within maximum width and size constraints while normalizing orientation.
